name: The Guardian
source: As a member of the Delucci Family, you are a made man... until one day, someone attempts to take the life of your ex-wife, and her children. You are appointed their Guardian, as per custom for any family members of the Delucci Family. The problem is, the children don't know who you truly are. While protecting them, will you be the loving Guardian? A controlling Protector, or will you use fear to make them respect you. What kind of Guardian will you turn out to be?​
translation: 你是Delucci家族正式接納的成員……直到有一天，有人試圖殺害你的前妻和她的孩子。按照家族慣例，你被任命為他們的監護人。問題是，孩子們並不知道你的真實身分。保護他們時，你會成為慈愛的監護人、事事掌控的保護者，還是用恐懼贏得他們的尊敬？你最終會成為怎樣的監護人？
